slots.name: discount amount
slots.sentence: New customers can get free Top Sirloin Steaks, Ranch Steaks or Tri Tip with every order for life, plus $100 off their first five boxes .

slots.name: menu items
slots.sentence: The service allows customers to customize their box from over 100 menu items, including USDA Choice and Prime steaks , 100% grass-fed beef, organic chicken, wild-caught seafood and more.

slots.name: Medium Box price
slots.sentence: 🥩 Medium Box, $149 per month : Ideal for individuals or small families, this plan includes a selection of up to 36 portions of high-quality cuts (six meat and seafood selections or up to 14 pounds) and the price per portion starts at $4.14.

slots.name: Large Box price
slots.sentence: 🍗 Large Box, $269 per month : Perfect for medium-sized families, the Large Box includes 72 portions of sustainable meat (12 selections or up to 28 pounds) and the price per portion starts at $3.74.

slots.name: Extra Large Box price
slots.sentence: 🍖 Extra Large Box, $359 per month : Designed for larger households or the most dedicated meat enthusiasts, the Extra Large Box features 108 portions of premium cuts (18 selections or up to 42 pounds) and the price per portion starts at $3.32.
